narrative.introduction: This domain covers edible fungi used as culinary ingredients worldwide — organized around how they're used in the kitchen, not biological taxonomy.
narrative.seo_description: Edible culinary fungi across four groups: Cultivated Mushrooms, Wild Mushrooms, Truffles, and Specialty Fungi.
